name: Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (original), cohort or case-control form
item_note: S1-S4 = Selection items 1-4; C = Comparability (0-2 stars); OE1-OE3 = Outcome items 1-3 (cohort form) or Exposure items 1-3 (case-control form), in the order of the scale.

choices.text: the factor you treated as the most important for comparability (first star)
the additional factor you used for the second comparability star
cohort form: the follow-up length you treated as long enough for the outcome to occur; case-control form: NA
cohort form: the loss to follow-up you treated as still adequate; case-control form: NA

choices_note: The scale leaves these choices to the reviewer. Make them yourself from the study topic and the scale's guidance, state them here, and apply them consistently when awarding stars.
